params.name: month

routes.name: budgets.history
routes.summary: One row per month, newest first, from the first month that had a budget: the budget and the actual for each side.

routes.name: recurring.list
routes.summary: Every recurring item, with its schedule, its next due date and whether it is active.

routes.name: recurring.dues

params.name: from

params.name: to

routes.name: stats.year

routes.summary: Income, expense and savings for each month of a year.

routes.name: stats.top

params.name: month
params.summary: The month, like 2026-10.

params.name: type
params.summary: INCOME or EXPENSE.

params.name: limit
params.summary: How many categories, 1 to 50. Default 5.

routes.summary: The categories with the most spending, or income, in a month, biggest first, with their share of the month.

routes.name: stats.commitments
routes.summary: What the active recurring items cost, or bring in, in an average month. Items with no fixed amount are listed but not counted.

routes.name: stats.planned

params.name: month
params.summary: The month, like 2026-10.

routes.summary: Planned against paid amounts of the recurring items that were paid in a month.

routes.summary: Changes the number and date format, the time zone or the language. Give at least one. The currency is changed in the app, and not while an account is in another currency.

routes.name: categories.create

params.name: name
params.summary: The name.

params.name: type
params.summary: INCOME or EXPENSE.

routes.summary: Makes a category. Its name is 1 to 50 characters and unique among the categories of that type.

routes.name: categories.rename

params.name: id
params.summary: The category.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

routes.summary: Renames a category. Its type cannot change.

routes.name: categories.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The category.

params.name: month
params.summary: The month the span counts from, like 2026-10.

params.name: span
params.summary: How far it reaches: ONLY (the default), FORWARD or ALL.

routes.summary: Deletes a category: it is no longer offered or budgeted, and its transactions keep it. With a month and a span, ONLY keeps the category and removes just that month's budget, FORWARD removes it from that month on (earlier months keep its budget and spending), ALL removes it from every month. Give month and span together, or neither.

routes.name: categories.reorder

params.name: ids
params.summary: Every active category of one type, in the new order.

routes.summary: Puts the categories of one type in a new order; give every active category of that type.

routes.name: transactions.create

params.name: name
params.summary: What it was, 1 to 50 characters.

params.name: amount
params.summary: More than zero, like 12.50. Always in the app's currency, which budgets and statistics count.

params.name: paymentDate
params.summary: The day it was paid.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Its type decides whether this is income or an expense.

params.name: description
params.summary: A note.

params.name: clientUuid
params.summary: A fresh UUID per transaction, so a retry cannot record it twice.

params.name: accountId
params.summary: The account it is in: where the money left or came in. The main account if left out. Not an archived one.

params.name: nativeAmount
params.summary: What really left or reached the account, in the account's currency, more than zero, like 20.00. Required when the account is in another currency than the app's, refused when it is not.

routes.summary: Records a transaction. With a clientUuid, sending the same request again gives back the first transaction instead of making another.

routes.name: transactions.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

params.name: amount
params.summary: The new amount, more than zero, in the app's currency.

params.name: paymentDate
params.summary: The new date.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The new category.

params.name: description
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

params.name: accountId
params.summary: Moves it to this account, which must not be archived.

params.name: nativeAmount
params.summary: The new amount in the account's currency, more than zero. Needed when it moves into an account in another currency than the app's; kept when it moves between such accounts and this is left out; refused for a row in an account in the app's currency, where moving it clears it.

routes.summary: Changes a transaction. Fields left out stay as they are; a null description clears it.

routes.name: transactions.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

routes.summary: Deletes a transaction. The change history keeps what it said.

routes.name: budgets.set

params.name: type
params.summary: INCOME or EXPENSE.

params.name: month
params.summary: The month, like 2026-10.

params.name: amountLimit
params.summary: The most to spend, or the aim to earn, each month. Zero is allowed.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Leave out for the global budget of that side.

params.name: span
params.summary: How far it reaches: ONLY (the default), FORWARD or ALL.

routes.summary: Sets a monthly budget: the global budget of a side, or one category's. Span ONLY (the default): a month that has already started changes only that month; this month and later ones carry the new amount forward. FORWARD: that month and every later one. ALL: every month back to the first budget month. A category budget must match the category's type.

routes.name: budgets.remove

params.name: type
params.summary: INCOME or EXPENSE.

params.name: month
params.summary: The month, like 2026-10.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Leave out for the global budget of that side.

params.name: span
params.summary: How far it reaches: ONLY (the default), FORWARD or ALL.

routes.summary: Removes a budget, with the same month and span rules as setting one (ONLY, FORWARD or ALL). With ONLY or FORWARD the months before keep it, and the history stays.

routes.name: recurring.create

params.name: name
params.summary: What it is, 1 to 50 characters.

params.name: amount
params.summary: The planned amount. Leave out for a bill that changes every time.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category.

params.name: startDate
params.summary: The first due date. Later dates are worked out from it.

params.name: intervalUnit
params.summary: DAY, WEEK, MONTH or YEAR.

params.name: intervalCount
params.summary: Every how many units, 1 to 1000.

params.name: endDate
params.summary: The last day it can fall due.

params.name: description
params.summary: A note.

params.name: accountId
params.summary: The account its payments are made in. The main account if left out. Not an archived one, and not one in another currency than the app's.

routes.summary: Adds a recurring item: a bill or an income that comes back every so many days, weeks, months or years.

routes.name: recurring.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

params.name: amount
params.summary: The new planned amount, or null for no fixed amount.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The new category.

params.name: startDate
params.summary: The new first due date.

params.name: intervalUnit
params.summary: DAY, WEEK, MONTH or YEAR.

params.name: intervalCount
params.summary: Every how many units, 1 to 1000.

params.name: endDate
params.summary: The new last day, or null for none.

params.name: description
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

params.name: accountId
params.summary: Moves its payments to this account, which must not be archived or in another currency than the app's.

routes.summary: Changes a recurring item. Fields left out stay as they are; null clears the end date or the description, and a null amount makes it a bill with no fixed amount.

routes.name: recurring.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Deletes a recurring item. The transactions it already made stay.

routes.name: recurring.pay

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: amount
params.summary: What was paid. Defaults to the planned amount.

params.name: paidOn
params.summary: The day it was paid. Defaults to today in the app's time zone.

params.name: dueDate
params.summary: Pay this one occurrence: on or after the next due date, and not already paid or skipped.

params.name: description
params.summary: Replaces the item's note on the transaction. Empty clears it.

routes.summary: Turns the current occurrence into a transaction and moves the item to the next one. With a due date, pays that one later occurrence instead and leaves the current one due. A bill with no fixed amount needs the amount.

routes.name: recurring.skip

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: dueDate
params.summary: Skip this one occurrence: on or after the next due date, and not already paid or skipped.

routes.summary: Passes over the current occurrence without making a transaction. With a due date, skips that one later occurrence instead.

routes.name: recurring.pause

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Pauses a recurring item: it stops coming due until it is resumed.

routes.name: recurring.resume

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Resumes a paused recurring item, unless its next date is past its end date.

routes.name: recurring.end

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Ends a recurring item for good: it becomes inactive and its end date is today. What it already paid stays.

params.name: from

routes.name: debts.reminders

params.name: everyDays
params.summary: The period in days, 0 to 365.

routes.summary: Which friends a reminder is due for today, and the next days with one. Every friend whose balance is not zero is reminded this many days after the day their debt last changed (the latest line of their statement), and again after as many; 0 is none. The app rings them (a device sets its own period and time of day); this only reads what they would be about.

routes.name: splits.preview

params.name: amount
params.summary: The bill, more than zero.

params.name: mode
params.summary: How the numbers are typed: EQUAL (everyone the same), PERCENT (two decimals, 100.00 in all), SHARES (whole numbers) or EXACT (amounts that add up to the bill).

params.name: mine
params.summary: Your own value, typed the way the mode says. Leave out for an equal split, or to take the rest in PERCENT and EXACT.

params.name: people
params.summary: The friends the bill is shared with, as ids.

params.name: guests
params.summary: People who are not tracked, by name, separated by commas. Their part leaves your cost and makes no debt.

params.name: values
params.summary: The value of each friend, in the order of --people, then of each guest, separated by commas. Not for an equal split. In PERCENT and EXACT one value, here or --mine, may be left empty (30.00,,20.00) and gets the rest.

routes.summary: What a split would give each person for a bill of this amount, without saving anything: your part, theirs, whether the numbers add up and how much is left.

routes.name: people.create

params.name: name
params.summary: The name.

routes.summary: Adds a friend. A friend is a name, 1 to 50 characters, unique among the friends who are not archived. Nothing else about a person is kept.

routes.name: people.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The friend.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

params.name: remindOn
params.summary: Not used for reminders any more; kept as it was written. Null clears it.

params.name: remindEveryDays
params.summary: Not used for reminders any more; kept as it was written, 1 to 365, or null.

routes.summary: Renames a friend. Fields left out stay as they are. The reminder fields are kept for data written before reminders became a setting of each device (every so many days after a debt last changed), and nothing rings from them.

routes.name: people.archive

params.name: id
params.summary: The friend.

routes.summary: Hides a friend from the lists and pickers. Their balance and history stay, and the name can be used again.

routes.name: people.unarchive

params.name: id
params.summary: The friend.

routes.summary: Brings back an archived friend, if no other friend has taken the name.

routes.name: people.settle

params.name: id
params.summary: The friend.

params.name: amount
params.summary: How much was paid, more than zero. The whole balance if left out.

params.name: date
params.summary: The day it was paid. Today if left out.

params.name: note
params.summary: A note, up to 200 characters.

params.name: transactionId
params.summary: A transaction the payment was for, such as a bill you paid for them. Only a reference: no amount changes.

params.name: accountId
params.summary: The account the money reached or left. The main account if left out. Not an archived one, and not one in another currency than the app's.

routes.summary: Marks a payment between you and a friend: they paid you back if they owe you, you paid them back if you owe them. With no amount it is the whole balance. An amount larger than the debt is accepted: the balance turns around and the answer says how much was over.

routes.name: ledger.add

params.name: personId
params.summary: The friend.

params.name: kind
params.summary: LENT (you lent), BORROWED (you borrowed), REPAID_TO_ME (they paid you back) or REPAID_BY_ME (you paid them back).

params.name: amount
params.summary: More than zero.

params.name: date
params.summary: The day it happened.

params.name: note
params.summary: A note, up to 200 characters.

params.name: transactionId
params.summary: A transaction this belongs to.

params.name: expenseName
params.summary: BORROWED only: the name of the expense that is made for your share (1 to 50 characters). Needs expenseCategoryId.

params.name: expenseCategoryId
params.summary: BORROWED only: the expense category for your share. Needs expenseName.

params.name: accountId
params.summary: The account the money reached or left (for a borrowing with an expense, the expense too is in it). The main account if left out. Not an archived one, and not one in another currency than the app's.

routes.summary: Records money lent, borrowed or paid back with a friend. It is never income or expense. For a borrowing, give expenseName and expenseCategoryId to add your share to your expenses in the same step, with the entry linked to it.

routes.name: ledger.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The entry.

params.name: personId
params.summary: The friend.

params.name: kind
params.summary: LENT, BORROWED, REPAID_TO_ME or REPAID_BY_ME.

params.name: amount
params.summary: More than zero.

params.name: date
params.summary: The day it happened.

params.name: note
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

params.name: transactionId
params.summary: The transaction it belongs to, or null for none.

params.name: accountId
params.summary: Moves it to this account, which must not be archived or in another currency than the app's.

routes.summary: Changes an entry of the ledger. Fields left out stay as they are; a null note or transactionId clears it. The expense it came with is not changed.

routes.name: ledger.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The entry.

routes.summary: Deletes an entry of the ledger. The balance of the friend changes by that much. The change history keeps what it said.

routes.name: transactions.split

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

params.name: mode
params.summary: How the numbers are typed: EQUAL (everyone the same), PERCENT (two decimals, 100.00 in all), SHARES (whole numbers) or EXACT (amounts that add up to the bill).

params.name: mine
params.summary: Your own value, typed the way the mode says. Leave out for an equal split, or to take the rest in PERCENT and EXACT.

params.name: people
params.summary: The friends the bill is shared with, as ids.

params.name: guests
params.summary: People who are not tracked, by name, separated by commas. Their part leaves your cost and makes no debt.

params.name: values
params.summary: The value of each friend, in the order of --people, then of each guest, separated by commas. Not for an equal split. In PERCENT and EXACT one value, here or --mine, may be left empty (30.00,,20.00) and gets the rest.

params.name: paidBy
params.summary: The friend who paid the bill, one of --people. Leave out when you paid. Then your part must be above zero: you owe the friend your part, and the others on the bill owe the friend too.

routes.summary: Shares a transaction with friends and guests. It keeps the amount that was paid; your part, the amount minus theirs, is what budgets and statistics count. The numbers must add up. Only an expense can be shared.

routes.name: transactions.unsplit

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

routes.summary: Takes the split off a transaction: it costs you its whole amount again, and the friends' balances go down by their parts.

routes.name: recurring.split

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: mode
params.summary: How the numbers are typed: EQUAL (everyone the same), PERCENT (two decimals, 100.00 in all), SHARES (whole numbers) or EXACT (amounts that add up to the bill).

params.name: mine
params.summary: Your own value, typed the way the mode says. Leave out for an equal split, or to take the rest in PERCENT and EXACT.

params.name: people
params.summary: The friends the bill is shared with, as ids.

params.name: guests
params.summary: People who are not tracked, by name, separated by commas. Their part leaves your cost and makes no debt.

params.name: values
params.summary: The value of each friend, in the order of --people, then of each guest, separated by commas. Not for an equal split. In PERCENT and EXACT one value, here or --mine, may be left empty (30.00,,20.00) and gets the rest.

params.name: paidBy
params.summary: The friend who paid the bill, one of --people. Leave out when you paid. Then your part must be above zero: you owe the friend your part, and the others on the bill owe the friend too.

routes.summary: Splits every payment of a recurring item the same way, from now on. Kept as proportions, so a payment that differs from the plan is shared in the same proportions. EXACT needs an item with an amount that the values add up to. Payments already made are not changed.

routes.name: recurring.unsplit

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Takes the split off a recurring item: its payments are not split from now on. Payments already made keep theirs.

routes.name: export.debts

params.name: out
params.summary: Where to write the file: an absolute path ending in .txt (TEXT), .csv (CSV) or .pdf (PDF), in a folder that exists, that is not there yet.

params.name: what
params.summary: SUMMARY (the default), STATEMENT or LEDGER.

params.name: format
params.summary: TEXT (the default), CSV or PDF. LEDGER is CSV only.

params.name: personId
params.summary: The friend, for a STATEMENT.

routes.summary: Writes who owes what to a text, CSV or PDF file, in English, after the person allows it in the app: the SUMMARY of all friends, the STATEMENT of one friend (personId), or the LEDGER of every entry as CSV. An existing file is never replaced.

routes.name: accounts.list
routes.summary: The accounts in the person's order, the archived ones last, each with what it holds today (balance), what changed this month, its last activity and how many rows (entries) are in it, and its details: BIC, notes, group, whether net worth counts it, and the virtual balance with what is available (balance plus virtual balance). An account in another currency (foreign true) has its figures in that currency, with the rate typed for it and balanceInMain, its balance in the app's currency. The main account has isMain true.

routes.name: accounts.show

params.name: id
params.summary: The account.

params.name: from
params.summary: The first day. The first of this month if left out.

params.name: to
params.summary: The last day. The last of this month if left out.

routes.summary: One account and what moved it from one day to another, both included, oldest first: each line with what it did to the account (negative: money left) and the balance after it, and the balance before the first day and after the last. All in the account's currency (currency). This month if the days are left out.

routes.name: accounts.history

params.name: id
params.summary: The account.

params.name: year
params.summary: The year, like 2026.

routes.summary: What an account held at the end of each month of a year, for a chart, in the account's currency: on the last day of a month that is over, today for this month, and no point for a month that has not begun.

routes.name: accounts.breakdown

params.name: id
params.summary: The account.

params.name: from
params.summary: The first day. The first of this month if left out.

params.name: to
params.summary: The last day. The last of this month if left out.

routes.summary: What an account paid out and took in from one day to another, both included, by category: for expenses and for income the categories with their amounts, the largest first, and the total of each, in the account's currency (currency). Transfers, ledger entries and a bill a friend paid are not in it. This month if the days are left out.

routes.name: accounts.summary
routes.summary: Net worth, in the app's currency: what the accounts that count in it hold in all (the archived ones too, an account in another currency turned into the app's currency at its rate), what friends owe you (negative: you owe them) and the two added. An account can be left out of net worth, and a virtual balance is never in it. Also how many accounts there are, those left out too, and whether accounts are in use: there is more than the main account, or it has an opening balance.

routes.name: transfers.list

params.name: accountId
params.summary: Only the transfers that leave or reach this account.

params.name: from
params.summary: Only on or after this date.

params.name: to
params.summary: Only on or before this date.

params.name: limit
params.summary: How many to return, 1 to 100. Default 50.

params.name: offset
params.summary: How many to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

routes.summary: Transfers between your accounts, newest first, with the total that match. Up to 100 a page, 50 unless limit says otherwise. A transfer is never income or expense. Between accounts in different currencies, amount is what left the first, in its currency, and toAmount what reached the second, in its currency.

routes.name: accounts.create

params.name: name
params.summary: The name.

params.name: kind
params.summary: CHECKING (a bank account), SAVINGS, CASH or CREDIT_CARD.

params.name: number
params.summary: An IBAN or anything that tells it apart, up to 50 characters.

params.name: openingBalance
params.summary: What it held on the opening date, which may be negative, like -120.00. 0.00 if left out.

params.name: openingDate
params.summary: The day it held that. Today if left out.

params.name: bic
params.summary: The bank's BIC, up to 20 characters.

params.name: notes
params.summary: Notes, up to 1000 characters. Line breaks are kept.

params.name: group
params.summary: The group it is listed under, like Bank, up to 50 characters.

params.name: includeInNetWorth
params.summary: Whether net worth counts it. True if left out.

params.name: virtualBalance
params.summary: An amount added to the balance to show what is available, like the limit of a credit card, which may be negative, like -50.00. It is never in the balance or in net worth. 0.00 if left out.

params.name: currency
params.summary: The currency of the account, three letters like RON, in any case. Left out, or the app's own currency, makes an account in the app's currency, which takes no rate. Another code needs a rate.

params.name: rate
params.summary: How many units of its currency one unit of the app's currency buys, like 5.00 for 1 EUR = 5.00 RON: more than zero, up to 8 decimals. Required with another currency, refused without one. You type it; nothing is fetched.

routes.summary: Adds an account at the end of the list. Its name is 1 to 50 characters and unique among the accounts that are not archived, whatever the case.

routes.name: accounts.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The account.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

params.name: kind
params.summary: CHECKING, SAVINGS, CASH or CREDIT_CARD.

params.name: number
params.summary: The new number, or null to clear it.

params.name: openingBalance
params.summary: What it held on the opening date, which may be negative, like -120.00.

params.name: openingDate
params.summary: The day it held that.

params.name: bic
params.summary: The new BIC, or null to clear it.

params.name: notes
params.summary: The new notes, or null to clear them.

params.name: group

params.name: includeInNetWorth
params.summary: Whether net worth counts it.

params.name: virtualBalance
params.summary: The new virtual balance, which may be negative, like -50.00.

params.name: currency
params.summary: The new currency, three letters like RON, in any case. Only while nothing is in the account (entries is 0), and never for the main account. Another code than the app's needs a rate, here or already there; the app's own currency clears the rate.

params.name: rate
params.summary: The new rate, like 5.00 for 1 EUR = 5.00 RON: more than zero, up to 8 decimals. Changes balanceInMain and net worth, and no amount that is stored. Refused for the main account and for an account in the app's currency, unless currency in the same request makes it another.

params.name: balance
params.summary: What the account holds today, in its own currency, which may be negative, like -50.00: its opening balance moves by the difference. Not together with openingBalance, and refused when the opening date is after today.

routes.summary: Changes an account that is not archived (bring it back first). Fields left out stay as they are; a null number, BIC, notes or group clears it.

routes.name: accounts.archive

params.name: id
params.summary: The account.

routes.summary: Takes an account out of the lists and pickers. Its rows, history and balance stay, and it still counts in the net worth. The main account cannot be archived; archiving an archived account changes nothing.

routes.name: accounts.unarchive

params.name: id
params.summary: The account.

routes.summary: Brings back an archived account, if no other account has taken its name. An account that is not archived is answered as it is.

routes.name: accounts.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The account.

routes.summary: Deletes an account that nothing is in: no transaction, recurring item, ledger entry or transfer. The main account is never deleted, and an account with rows is archived instead.

routes.name: accounts.reorder

params.name: ids
params.summary: Every account that is not archived, in the new order.

routes.summary: Puts the accounts in a new order; give every account that is not archived, each once.

params.summary: The day it moved.

params.name: note
params.summary: A note, up to 200 characters.

params.name: toAmount
params.summary: What reaches the second account, in its currency, more than zero, like 200.00. Required when the two accounts are in different currencies, refused when they are in the same.

routes.summary: Moves money between two of your accounts. It is never income or expense and is in no budget or statistic: only the two balances change. The accounts must differ and neither may be archived. Between accounts in different currencies it needs toAmount.

routes.name: transfers.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The transfer.

params.name: fromAccountId
params.summary: The account the money leaves.

params.name: toAccountId
params.summary: The account the money reaches.

params.name: amount
params.summary: More than zero, like 200.00, in the currency of the account it leaves.

params.name: date
params.summary: The day it moved.

params.name: note
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

params.name: toAmount
params.summary: What reaches the second account, in its currency, more than zero. Needed when the two accounts, as they are after this change, are in different currencies and the transfer has none yet; refused when they are in the same currency (a stored one is then cleared).

routes.name: transfers.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The transfer.

routes.summary: Deletes a transfer. The balances of both accounts change by that much. The change history keeps what it said.
